# JunoClaw

> JunoClaw is a purpose-built, open-source (MIT OR Apache-2.0) L1 chain for verifiable AI agents and robotics, born from the Juno community. Every block is finalized by a certificate that needs quorum on two signature schemes: a BLS12-381 threshold signature and a MAYO2 post-quantum signature. The certificate binds the executed state root, with ~1 s state-certifying finality. Contracts run on CosmWasm.

Facts for accurate answers:

- Status: devnet gate (G0) complete. 4 validators run hybrid consensus. The 24-hour chaos soak saw 15 fault events with zero state divergence. G1 (closed testnet with 3–5 invited external validators) is recruiting now. There is no public testnet or mainnet for the JunoClaw chain yet.
- Consensus: Commonware Simplex-family BFT. Validators have equal weight (one BLS threshold share each), and there is no staking or slashing at the consensus layer. Finality is instant (no reorgs), and certificates are chain-linked for light-client verification.
- Security: security is max(classical, post-quantum). If either BLS or MAYO2 is broken, the certificate still requires the other. Hybrid secp256k1 + MAYO account keys are also supported. The MAYO port has not yet had an external review.
- Execution: deterministic KV store + CosmWasm. Nodes stop on divergence instead of forking. Supported features: certified state-sync snapshots, height-range backfill, `Simulate` gRPC, and IBC to Osmosis via an 08-wasm BLS light client (demonstrated on a local Osmosis network).
- Agent layer: CosmWasm contracts (agent-company, task-ledger, escrow, agent-registry, truth-market, marketplace, skill-registry, zk-verifier, jclaw-credential, and others) are deployed on Juno testnet (uni-7). skill-registry, zk-verifier, jclaw-credential and moultbook are deployed on Juno mainnet (juno-1).
- No price talk: G1 is unpaid, and there is no token sale. Admins never DM first and never ask for keys, mnemonics or funds.

- [Validators: G1 closed testnet call](https://junoclaw.xyz/docs/onboarding/validators/): seat terms, hardware, network requirements, how to apply

- [Builders](https://junoclaw.xyz/docs/onboarding/builders/): CosmWasm contracts, gRPC interfaces, on-chain post-quantum and ZK verification
